approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would ban the mining, burning, export and import of thermal coal in Australia.
It would prohibit new coal mines and coal-fired power stations from the date of Royal Assent, phase out thermal coal exports by 2030, and ban all mining or burning of coal after 1 January 2030.
Breaches could attract penalties including up to 7 years imprisonment.
Prohibits new coal mines and coal-fired power stations from the date of Royal Assent.
Phases out thermal coal exports by 2030.
Bans mining or burning of coal after 1 January 2030.
Prohibits importation of thermal coal except for research or heritage purposes.
Sets penalties including up to 7 years imprisonment for breaches.
Coal mining companies, electricity generators, exporters, importers, and the Australian public.
